subject: Re: Project Obsidian kickoff — Cluster-GCN on our entity graphs
body:
Closing out Obsidian's window — decisions from this morning's review.

Results: internal entity-graph model beats retrieval's sampled-GCN baseline by +3.1 on their ranking eval at 0.45x the GPU cost. Under half. The hub-node concern turned out manageable — Wei's ablation showed stochastic multiple partitions recovers most of it; hub accuracy trails by only 0.8 and retrieval considers that acceptable for v1.

Decisions:
1) Hand off to retrieval as planned. Csilla owns the transition doc; Jorge packages the training pipeline (with the METIS_DLL fix baked in) as a reusable recipe.
2) The hybrid batching scheme for hub nodes is NOT pursued now — parked with Wei's ablation data attached for whoever picks it up.
3) Wei writes a short internal tech note comparing depth: 5-layer vs 2-layer gains on our graph.

Thanks all — textbook project.

Anders
